title: Functions, Rational Expressions & Complex Numbers
sub: 20 FRQs + 25 MCQs • Difficulty Progression • Cross-Lesson Synthesis

sections.heading: Part I — Free-Response Questions (FRQs): Foundational Fluency (1–7)

questions.q: Factor the numerator and denominator completely, state all domain restrictions, and simplify $\dfrac{2x^2 - 5x - 12}{x^2 - 16}$.
questions.answer:
Factor: $\dfrac{(2x + 3)(x - 4)}{(x - 4)(x + 4)}$. Domain restrictions: $x 
eq 4$ and $x 
eq -4$. Canceling $x - 4$ yields $\dfrac{2x + 3}{x + 4}$ for $x 
eq \pm 4$.

questions.q: Combine over a common denominator and simplify into a single reduced fraction: $\dfrac{3}{x - 2} - \dfrac{2x - 1}{x^2 - 4}$.
Solve the rational equation $\dfrac{4}{x - 1} + \dfrac{2}{x + 3} = 1$ for all valid real solutions.
questions.answer: Multiply by $(x - 1)(x + 3)$: $4(x + 3) + 2(x - 1) = (x - 1)(x + 3) \Rightarrow 6x + 10 = x^2 + 2x - 3 \Rightarrow x^2 - 4x - 13 = 0 \Rightarrow x = 2 \pm \sqrt{17}$ (neither equals $1$ or $-3$).

questions.q: Perform each complex number operation and write the result in standard form $a + bi$:
questions.answer: Use $i^2 = -1$ and combine real and imaginary parts.

questions.q: Divide the complex numbers $\dfrac{14 - 5i}{3 + 2i}$ by multiplying numerator and denominator by the complex conjugate, and express the result in the form $a + bi$.
Simplify $i^{45} + i^{102} - i^{79}$ using the periodicity of powers of $i$ ($i^4 = 1$).
questions.answer: Divide each exponent by $4$: $45 = 4(11) + 1 \Rightarrow i^{45} = i$; $102 = 4(25) + 2 \Rightarrow i^{102} = i^2 = -1$; $79 = 4(19) + 3 \Rightarrow i^{79} = i^3 = -i$. Thus $i + (-1) - (-i) = -1 + 2i$.

questions.q: State the vertical asymptote, horizontal asymptote, $x$-intercept, and $y$-intercept of the rational function $f(x) = \dfrac{2x - 6}{x - 1}$ graphed below.
questions.answer: Vertical asymptote: $x = 1$; horizontal asymptote: $y = \dfrac{2}{1} = 2$; $x$-intercept: $2x - 6 = 0 \Rightarrow (3, 0)$; $y$-intercept: $f(0) = 6 \Rightarrow (0, 6)$.

sections.heading: Part I — Free-Response Questions (FRQs): Intermediate Modeling (8–14)

questions.q: Solve the rational equation $\dfrac{x}{x - 3} - \dfrac{3}{x - 3} = 2$ and explain why it has no solution.
questions.answer: Multiplying both sides by $x - 3$ (for $x \neq 3$) gives $x - 3 = 2(x - 3) \Rightarrow x = 3$. However, $x = 3$ makes the denominator $x - 3 = 0$, so $x = 3$ is an extraneous solution and the equation has no solution.

questions.q: Find the constants $A$ and $B$ in the partial-fraction identity $\dfrac{5x + 1}{(x - 1)(x + 2)} = \dfrac{A}{x - 1} + \dfrac{B}{x + 2}$.
questions.answer: Multiply by $(x - 1)(x + 2)$: $5x + 1 = A(x + 2) + B(x - 1)$. Setting $x = 1$ gives $6 = 3A \Rightarrow A = 2$. Setting $x = -2$ gives $-9 = -3B \Rightarrow B = 3$.

questions.q: Simplify the complex fraction $\dfrac{\dfrac{1}{x} - \dfrac{1}{3}}{x - 3}$ for $x \neq 0, 3$, and evaluate the simplified expression at $x = 3$.
questions.answer: Combine the numerator: $\dfrac{\dfrac{3 - x}{3x}}{x - 3} = \dfrac{-(x - 3)}{3x(x - 3)} = -\dfrac{1}{3x}$. Evaluating at $x = 3$ gives $-\dfrac{1}{9}$.

questions.q: Find the complex conjugate solutions to $x^2 - 6x + 25 = 0$ in the form $a \pm bi$, and verify that their sum is $6$ and their product is $25$.
questions.answer: Complete the square: $(x - 3)^2 = -16 \Rightarrow x - 3 = \pm 4i \Rightarrow x = 3 \pm 4i$. Sum $= (3 + 4i) + (3 - 4i) = 6$; Product $= 3^2 + 4^2 = 9 + 16 = 25$.

questions.q: Use polynomial long division to rewrite $\dfrac{2x^2 + 5x - 1}{x + 3}$ in the form $ax + b + \dfrac{r}{x + 3}$.

Two resistors $R_1$ and $R_2$ connected in parallel have equivalent resistance $R_{\mathrm{eq}}$ given by $\dfrac{1}{R_{\mathrm{eq}}} = \dfrac{1}{R_1} + \dfrac{1}{R_2}$. Solve for $R_2$ in terms of $R_{\mathrm{eq}}$ and $R_1$, and compute $R_2$ when $R_{\mathrm{eq}} = 12\,\Omega$ and $R_1 = 20\,\Omega$.
questions.answer: $\dfrac{1}{R_2} = \dfrac{1}{R_{\mathrm{eq}}} - \dfrac{1}{R_1} = \dfrac{R_1 - R_{\mathrm{eq}}}{R_{\mathrm{eq}} R_1} \Rightarrow R_2 = \dfrac{R_{\mathrm{eq}} R_1}{R_1 - R_{\mathrm{eq}}}$. For $R_{\mathrm{eq}} = 12, R_1 = 20$: $R_2 = \dfrac{12(20)}{20 - 12} = \dfrac{240}{8} = 30\,\Omega$.

questions.q: Solve the rational inequality $\dfrac{x - 4}{x + 2} \leq 0$ and express the solution set in interval notation.
questions.answer: The critical values are the zero $x = 4$ (included) and the vertical asymptote $x = -2$ (strictly excluded, since division by zero is undefined). Sign analysis shows $\dfrac{x - 4}{x + 2} \leq 0$ on $(-2, 4]$.

sections.heading: Part I — Free-Response Questions (FRQs): Challenging & Cross-Lesson Synthesis (15–20)

questions.q: A polynomial $P(x)$ of degree $3$ with real coefficients has zeros $x = 2$ and $x = 1 + 3i$, and satisfies $P(0) = -40$. Find the factored and expanded forms of $P(x)$.
questions.answer: By the Complex Conjugate Root Theorem, $1 - 3i$ is also a zero. The quadratic factor for $1 \pm 3i$ is $(x - 1)^2 + 9 = x^2 - 2x + 10$. Thus $P(x) = a(x - 2)(x^2 - 2x + 10)$. Since $P(0) = -20a = -40 \Rightarrow a = 2$, we get $P(x) = 2(x - 2)(x^2 - 2x + 10) = 2x^3 - 8x^2 + 28x - 40$.

questions.q: Find the domain, removable discontinuity (hole) coordinates, and vertical asymptote of $g(x) = \dfrac{x^2 - 9}{x^2 - x - 6}$.
questions.answer: Factor numerator and denominator: $g(x) = \dfrac{(x - 3)(x + 3)}{(x - 3)(x + 2)}$. The domain is $x \neq -2, 3$. The factor $x - 3$ cancels, giving $g(x) = \dfrac{x + 3}{x + 2}$ for $x \neq 3$: thus there is a removable discontinuity (hole) at $\left(3, \dfrac{6}{5}\right)$ and a vertical asymptote at $x = -2$.

questions.q: A kayaker paddles $12\,\mathrm{km}$ upstream and $12\,\mathrm{km}$ back downstream in a river whose current flows at $3\,\mathrm{km/h}$. If the total round-trip time is $3$ hours, set up a rational equation to find the kayaker's speed $v$ in still water.
questions.answer: Time equation: $\dfrac{12}{v - 3} + \dfrac{12}{v + 3} = 3$. Multiply by $(v - 3)(v + 3) = v^2 - 9$: $12(v + 3) + 12(v - 3) = 3(v^2 - 9) \Rightarrow 24v = 3v^2 - 27 \Rightarrow v^2 - 8v - 9 = 0 \Rightarrow (v - 9)(v + 1) = 0$. Since $v > 3$, $v = 9\,\mathrm{km/h}$.

questions.q: For a one-to-one rational function $f(x) = \dfrac{3x + 2}{x - 4}$ ($x \neq 4$), find the formula for its inverse function $f^{-1}(x)$ and state the domain and range of $f$.
questions.answer: Set $y = \dfrac{3x + 2}{x - 4} \Rightarrow y(x - 4) = 3x + 2 \Rightarrow x(y - 3) = 4y + 2 \Rightarrow x = \dfrac{4y + 2}{y - 3}$. Thus $f^{-1}(x) = \dfrac{4x + 2}{x - 3}$. The domain of $f$ is $x \neq 4$ and the range of $f$ (domain of $f^{-1}$) is $y \neq 3$.

questions.target: Modulus Algebra in the Complex Plane
questions.q: In the complex plane, find the modulus $|z|$ of $z = \dfrac{(3 + 4i)(1 - i)}{2 - 2i}$ without expanding the numerator.
questions.answer: Using the multiplicative property of moduli $|z_1 z_2 / z_3| = |z_1||z_2|/|z_3|$: $|3 + 4i| = 5$, $|1 - i| = \sqrt{2}$, and $|2 - 2i| = 2\sqrt{2}$. Therefore $|z| = \dfrac{5\sqrt{2}}{2\sqrt{2}} = \dfrac{5}{2} = 2.5$.

questions.q: If $x > 0$ and $x + \dfrac{4}{x} = 6$, find the exact value of $x^2 + \dfrac{16}{x^2}$ and the minimum possible value of $t + \dfrac{4}{t}$ for all $t > 0$.
questions.answer: Square $x + \dfrac{4}{x} = 6$: $x^2 + 8 + \dfrac{16}{x^2} = 36 \Rightarrow x^2 + \dfrac{16}{x^2} = 28$. For any $t > 0$, $t + \dfrac{4}{t} = \left(\sqrt{t} - \dfrac{2}{\sqrt{t}}\right)^2 + 4 \geq 4$, with minimum value $4$ achieved at $t = 2$.

sections.heading: Part II — Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs): Foundational Concepts (21–28)

questions.q: Given the algebraic relationship in which for $x \neq 3$, which expression is equivalent to $\dfrac{x^2 - 9}{x - 3}$?
questions.answer: Factor the difference of squares: $\dfrac{(x - 3)(x + 3)}{x - 3} = x + 3$.

questions.q: If $i = \sqrt{-1}$, what is the sum $(7 - 4i) + (-2 + 9i)$?
questions.answer: Combine real parts and imaginary parts: $(7 - 2) + (-4 + 9)i = 5 + 5i$.

questions.q: What is the vertical asymptote of the graph of $f(x) = \dfrac{5}{2x + 8}$?
questions.answer: Set the denominator equal to zero: $2x + 8 = 0 \Rightarrow x = -4$.

questions.q: Within the real coordinate domain, to satisfy the synthesis condition, if $\dfrac{6}{x - 2} = \dfrac{3}{4}$, what is the value of $x$?
questions.answer: Cross-multiply: $3(x - 2) = 24 \Rightarrow x - 2 = 8 \Rightarrow x = 10$.

questions.q: What is the product $(4 + 3i)(4 - 3i)$?
questions.answer: Multiplying complex conjugates gives $a^2 + b^2 = 4^2 + 3^2 = 16 + 9 = 25$.

questions.q: Combine the rational terms $\dfrac{2}{x} + \dfrac{5}{3x}$ ($x \neq 0$) into a single simplified fraction.
questions.answer: Use the common denominator $3x$: $\dfrac{6}{3x} + \dfrac{5}{3x} = \dfrac{11}{3x}$.

questions.q: What is the value of $i^{26}$?
For what value of $x$ is the function $h(x) = \dfrac{x + 5}{x^2 - 6x + 9}$ undefined?
questions.answer: The denominator factors as $(x - 3)^2 = 0$, so $h(x)$ is undefined at $x = 3$.

sections.heading: Part II — Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs): Intermediate Exam Practice (29–37)

questions.q: Rewrite the improper rational function $\dfrac{3x + 7}{x + 2}$ ($x \neq -2$) in quotient-plus-remainder form.
questions.answer: Rewrite the numerator as $3(x + 2) + 1$: $\dfrac{3(x + 2) + 1}{x + 2} = 3 + \dfrac{1}{x + 2}$.

questions.q: Analyze the configuration in which when $\dfrac{10}{1 - 2i}$ is written in the form $a + bi$, what is the value of $a + b$?
What are all real solutions to $\dfrac{x^2}{x - 4} = \dfrac{16}{x - 4}$?
questions.answer: For $x \neq 4$, $x^2 = 16 \Rightarrow x = \pm 4$. Since $x = 4$ makes the denominator zero (extraneous), the only valid solution is $x = -4$.

questions.q: What is the horizontal asymptote of $f(x) = \dfrac{6x^2 - 5x + 1}{2x^2 + 9}$?
questions.answer: Since numerator and denominator have equal degree ($2$), the horizontal asymptote is the ratio of leading coefficients: $y = \dfrac{6}{2} = 3$.

questions.q: If $\dfrac{4x - 2}{x^2 - 1} = \dfrac{A}{x - 1} + \dfrac{B}{x + 1}$ for all $x \neq \pm 1$, what is the value of $A$?
questions.answer: Multiply by $x^2 - 1$: $4x - 2 = A(x + 1) + B(x - 1)$. Substitute $x = 1$: $2 = 2A \Rightarrow A = 1$ (and at $x = -1$, $-6 = -2B \Rightarrow B = 3$).

questions.q: Simplify the compound reciprocal fraction $\dfrac{\dfrac{1}{a} + \dfrac{1}{b}}{\dfrac{1}{ab}}$ for positive real numbers $a, b > 0$.
questions.answer: Multiply numerator and denominator by $ab$: $(b + a) / 1 = a + b$.

questions.q: If $(x + yi)(2 - i) = 8 + i$, where $x$ and $y$ are real numbers, what is the value of $x + y$?

questions.target: Rational Expressions for Combined Work Rates
questions.q: Printer A can print a batch of reports in $x$ hours, and Printer B can print the same batch in $x + 3$ hours. Which expression represents the fraction of the batch they can print together in $1$ hour?
questions.answer: Their combined hourly rate is $\dfrac{1}{x} + \dfrac{1}{x + 3} = \dfrac{(x + 3) + x}{x(x + 3)} = \dfrac{2x + 3}{x(x + 3)}$.

questions.target: Reconstructing Quadratics from Complex Conjugate Roots
questions.q: Which of the following quadratic equations has roots $2 + i$ and $2 - i$?
questions.answer: Sum of roots $= (2 + i) + (2 - i) = 4$; product of roots $= 2^2 + 1^2 = 5$. Thus the monic quadratic is $x^2 - 4x + 5 = 0$.

sections.heading: Part II — Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs): Challenging & Cross-Lesson Synthesis (38–45)

questions.q: What is the value of the sum $i^1 + i^2 + i^3 + \dots + i^{99}$?
questions.answer: Every block of $4$ consecutive powers of $i$ sums to $i - 1 - i + 1 = 0$. Since $99 = 4(24) + 3$, the first $96$ terms sum to $0$, leaving $i^{97} + i^{98} + i^{99} = i + (-1) + (-i) = -1$.

questions.q: In the $xy$-plane, at how many points does the rational curve $y = \dfrac{6}{x}$ intersect the line $x + y = 5$?
questions.answer: Substitute $y = 5 - x$: $\dfrac{6}{x} = 5 - x \Rightarrow x^2 - 5x + 6 = 0 \Rightarrow (x - 2)(x - 3) = 0$. This gives two intersection points: $(2, 3)$ and $(3, 2)$.

questions.q: A chemistry student adds $x$ liters of pure water to $20$ liters of a $40\%$ acid solution. Which rational function gives the new acid concentration $C(x)$ as a decimal, and what is $\lim_{x \to \infty} C(x)$?
questions.answer: Pure acid remains constant at $0.40(20) = 8$ liters, while total volume becomes $20 + x$ liters, so $C(x) = \dfrac{8}{20 + x} \to 0$ as $x \to \infty$.

questions.q: For how many integer values of $n$ is $\dfrac{2n + 15}{n + 2}$ also an integer?
questions.answer: Divide: $\dfrac{2n + 15}{n + 2} = \dfrac{2(n + 2) + 11}{n + 2} = 2 + \dfrac{11}{n + 2}$. This is an integer if and only if $n + 2$ divides the prime $11$, i.e. $n + 2 \in \{\pm 1, \pm 11\}$ ($4$ integer values of $n$: $-13, -3, -1, 9$).

questions.target: 90-Degree Rotation by $i$ in the Complex Plane
questions.q: If $z = 3 + 4i$, what is the distance in the complex plane between $z$ and $i z$?
questions.answer: Multiplying by $i$ rotates $z$ by $90^{\circ}$ around the origin without changing its length $|z| = 5$ (specifically, $iz = -4 + 3i$). By the $45^{\circ}\mathrm{-}45^{\circ}\mathrm{-}90^{\circ}$ right triangle with legs $5$ and $5$, the distance $|z - iz|$ is $5\sqrt{2}$.

questions.q: What is the solution set to the rational inequality $\dfrac{x + 5}{x - 2} \geq 2$?
questions.answer: Subtract $2$: $\dfrac{x + 5 - 2(x - 2)}{x - 2} = \dfrac{9 - x}{x - 2} \geq 0 \Leftrightarrow \dfrac{x - 9}{x - 2} \leq 0$. Since $x = 2$ is excluded and $x = 9$ is included, the solution set is $(2, 9]$.

questions.target: Inverse Pythagorean Theorem for Right-Triangle Altitude
questions.q: A right triangle has legs of lengths $\dfrac{1}{a}$ and $\dfrac{1}{b}$, where $a, b > 0$. Which rational expression gives the length of the altitude drawn to the hypotenuse?
questions.answer: The inverse-Pythagorean altitude formula states $\dfrac{1}{h^2} = \dfrac{1}{leg_1^2} + \dfrac{1}{leg_2^2} = a^2 + b^2 \Rightarrow h = \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{a^2 + b^2}}$.

questions.q: If $f(x) = \dfrac{x - 1}{x + 1}$, what is $f(f(x))$ for all $x \neq -1, 0$?
